name: neogreennexus
description: Ecosistema Modular NeoGreenNexus (Web, Android APK & Nexus Core Desktop)

scripts.android:build: npx cap copy android && node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); cp.execSync('.\\android\\gradlew -p android assembleDebug', {env: {...process.env, JAVA_HOME: 'C:\\Program Files\\Eclipse Adoptium\\jdk-21.0.13.9-hotspot'}, stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.version: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('public/js/core/version.js', 'export const APP_VERSION = ' + JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version) + ';\n')" && git add public/js/core/version.js
scripts.deploy:all: npm run version:bump && npm run git:push && npm run desktop:build && npm run android:build && npm run release:upload && firebase deploy --only hosting
